title: K30000 / FA-CNC-01 Purchase Invoice Field-Mapping Gate

decision.scope: one narrow UI-first field-mapping run only
decision.reason: FIXEDASSETS-053 proves the Purchase Invoice page, required fields, line context and Post danger boundary but not target values. The next book-useful step is controlled target field mapping with mandatory draft cleanup and no posting.

allowedActions: open Purchase Invoices page 9308 in RM-DEMO
open one new Purchase Invoice context
test K30000 as Vendor in the header
enter a unique lab Vendor Invoice No. only if BC requires it for validation
test the purchase line Type needed for fixed assets
test FA-CNC-01 line selection only if the UI context is clear
capture screenshots only when target values or cleanup status are visible
delete or cancel any created draft through the UI before ending
forbiddenActions: leaving a draft purchase invoice behind
stopCriteria: fixed asset line type is not visible or not selectable
draft cannot be cleaned through the UI
proves: the next field-mapping run is allowed with strict no-posting boundaries
FIXEDASSETS-053 is only preflight evidence and not target invoice proof
draft cleanup is mandatory before any target value entry run can be useful
doesNotProve: K30000 entered on a purchase invoice
